crew.overview: Deep in the forests of the Pacific Northwest, a father devoted to raising his six kids with a rigorous physical and intellectual education is forced to leave his paradise and enter the world, beginning a journey that challenges his idea of what it means to be a parent.
crew.title: Captain Fantastic

details.biography: Samantha Housman is an American producer native of Boston. She first worked as a freelance AD. In 2008, she co-founded with Louise Runge an independent production company, ONEZERO Films.
details.name: Samantha Housman
